descriptions.witcher_rpg:aard: Telekinetic thrust that damages enemies and knocks them back.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:igni: Unleashes a stream of fire that damages and ignites enemies.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:yrden: Places a magic circle that slows enemies inside it.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:axii: Charms the target, so it stops attacking and takes more damage.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:quen: Creates a protective shield that absorbs damage.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:igni_firestream: A concentrated stream of fire that damages and ignites enemies.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:aard_sweep: A 360 degree telekinetic blast that damages and knocks back all nearby enemies.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:yrden_magic_trap: Places a magical trap that damages and slows enemies that enter it.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:axii_puppet: Dominates the target and turns it into an ally with more attack damage.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:quen_active_shield: An active shield that absorbs damage and heals you.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:fast_attack: A series of fast attacks with a small forward dash.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:witcher_senses: Reveals nearby enemies and exposes them: critical hits against them are stronger and more likely.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:battle_trance: Enter a battle trance that increases your attack damage.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:rend: A charged overhead strike that deals heavy damage and disables shields.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:whirl: A spinning attack that damages all nearby enemies and blocks arrows.
descriptions.witcher_rpg:defensive_witcher_mechanics: Sharpens your reflexes to block the next attack or arrow.
